items.t: Crankshaft pulley bolt breaks or loosens
items.job: Replace crank pulley, bolt and key; inspect timing belt
items.note: If the timing belt jumped and bent valves, cost rises a lot.

items.t: Crankshaft position sensor causes stalling
items.note: On this V6 the sensor sits behind the front pulley, so labor is higher than usual.

items.t: Idle control valve screw can fall into the engine
items.job: Replace idle control valve with updated part
items.note: A Kia service campaign covered this. If a screw entered the engine, repair costs much more.

items.t: Fuel line can rub through near the tank (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 05V-353 (Kia SC-052). Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-088. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Brake light switch failure (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 09V-130 or 13V-114. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Engine compartment fire risk (recall)
items.job: Install software; replace engine if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-750 or 23V-877. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: ABS/HECU control unit fire risk (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-331 or 23V-652. Park outside until it is repaired.

items.t: Engine bearing failure and seizure
items.job: Engine inspection; replace engine if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 17V-224 for 2012-2014 models. Later years may be covered by Kia's extended engine warranty; check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Fuel pipe leak after an engine replacement (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 18V-907. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Accelerator pedal may stop responding (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-089. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Rear crossmember weld can crack (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-480. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Shifter may leave Park without the brake (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-612. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Crankshaft may break and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Inspect crankshaft; replace engine if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 17V-586. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Tow hitch wiring module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-703. Park outside until it is repaired.

items.t: Dual-clutch transmission oil pump can cause loss of power (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-760. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Blower motor wiring can melt or catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace blower wiring harness and resistor (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-649. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Headlights and taillights can briefly go out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-006. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Turbocharger oil supply pipe can crack and leak (recall 22V-202)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-202. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Connecting rod bolts may be loose (recall 25V-548)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-548. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag can switch itself off for an adult
items.note: Free under recall 11V-473. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Add-on trailer wiring harness can overheat
items.note: Free under recall 11E-041 (CURT Manufacturing). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water in the camera wiring blanks the backup image
items.job: Waterproof or replace rear view camera (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-639. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear camera housing clips can break
items.note: Free under recall 23V-610. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering wiring may be put together wrongly
items.job: Inspect and repair power steering harness (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-287. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank from a software fault
items.note: Free under recall 26V-046, often over the air. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wrong spare tire can upset ABS and traction control
items.note: Free under recall 25V-745. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cowl crossbar weld can let the steering column move
items.note: Free under recall 18V-656. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Easy to start and steal without an immobilizer
items.note: Free at a Kia dealer for eligible key-start models; Kia says it takes about 1-2 hours. This is a service campaign, not a safety recall.

items.t: Direct-injection four burns oil between changes
items.job: Oil consumption test, then piston and ring or short-block replacement
items.note: Low end is the consumption test and reseal work; high end is a short block. Settlement coverage may apply.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner may throw fragments (hybrid recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-447. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Fuel line can be damaged in a frontal crash (plug-in hybrid recall)
items.job: Install protective covering on fuel line (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-920 (Kia SC328). Kia also reimburses owners who already paid for this repair.

items.t: Multi-function stalk switch contacts wear out
items.note: Covered by Kia warranty extension WTY031 for 15 years/150,000 miles on 2016-2018 Georgia-built Sorentos. Not a safety recall; check eligibility with a Kia dealer.
